name: Walking Plague Satchel
languages: Understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

Traits.name: Scuttle
Traits.text: The plague satchel ignores Difficult Terrain, and Opportunity Attacks against it are made with Disadvantage.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The plague satchel makes two Clasp attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Crushing Cascade.

Actions.name: Clasp
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

Actions.name: Crushing Cascade
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw*: DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* The target has the Prone condition.
Actions.clause: The plague satchel skitters a short distance on its stiff leather legs, then springs, jaws-clasp first, from that new po
Actions.expresses: skulks and hides, then lunges from cover

Bonus Actions.name: Nimble Escape
Bonus Actions.text: The plague satchel takes the Disengage or Hide action.

lore: Stitched together by a physician who kept his instruments too close, this bag walked out of a quarantine ward carrying his last, unfinished cure and a hunger to complete it on any patient it can catch.

generation.userConcept: a plague-doctor's bag that has learned to walk
generation.cite: composition after Phase Spider (CR 3) + Blink Dog; gaze after Mummy (CR 3)

immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
monsterDescription: a plague-doctor's bag that has learned to walk
